title: Are all my friends going to hell unless they join the Christian religion?

body:
If this question interests you, you’ll want to check out my e-book, “Is Jesus the Only Way?” I examine John 14:6 (“I am the way … no one comes to the Father but by me”) in its immediate context, as well as in the larger context of John and his unique angle on Jesus and his message. It’s only $3.99, and you can order here:  /archive

 You’ll find a lot of other resources there too – music, e-books, overviews of the Bible, etc.
